_meta.source: Old site https://defencegarden.com (React/Vite SPA). Strings copied verbatim from assets/index-BpgzKryG.js (company constant, SEO route map, Navbar, Footer, JSON-LD builder), index.html, prerendered route HTML, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, Contact/Legal/bookingReceipt chunks; cross-checked against the rendered live pages on 2026-10-12.
_meta.conventions: Every 'oldUrl' is an absolute URL on the old site (media still to be downloaded). Fields that do not exist on the old site are null with a note; nothing is invented. Keys named 'note', 'usedIn', 'where' and 'derived*' are editorial annotations, not site copy.
